title: DMC Global Inc. 8-K Filing — Amendment No. 2 to Stockholder Protection Rights Agreement
summary: DMC Global Inc. (ticker: BOOM) filed an 8-K on April 24, 2026, extending the expiration of its Stockholder Protection Rights Agreement (poison pill) by one year to June 4, 2027. The rights plan restricts any person or group from acquiring more than 10% beneficial ownership (or 20% for Passive Investors) of the company's common stock.
key_points: Amendment No. 2 extends the Rights expiration from June 4, 2026 to June 4, 2027
The original Stockholder Protection Rights Agreement was dated June 5, 2024
Amendment No. 1 extended the agreement on May 30, 2025
Rights restrict acquisition of 10% or more of common stock (20% for Passive Investors)
Rights Agent is Computershare Trust Company, N.A.
Company is incorporated in Delaware, traded on Nasdaq Global Select Market
